perk-survivalist.name: Survivalist
perk-survivalist.description: Finds food and shelter easily (+15 Survival).

perk-lucky.name: Lucky
perk-lucky.description: Rerolls one failed check per match.

perk-brute.name: Brute
perk-brute.description: Hits harder and takes more blows (+10 Melee, +4 HP).

perk-silver-tongue.name: Silver tongue
perk-silver-tongue.description: Talks their way out of anything (+10 Persuasion, +10 Deception).

perk-tough.name: Tough
perk-tough.description: Hard to bring down (+10 Endurance, +8 HP).

perk-quick.name: Quick
perk-quick.description: Fast on their feet, escapes easily (+10 Athletics).

perk-arcane-spark.name: Arcane spark
perk-arcane-spark.description: A touch of magic, even without training (+15 Magic).

perk-charming.name: Charming
perk-charming.description: Makes friends quickly (+5 Persuasion, alliances more likely).

perk-beast-friend.name: Beast friend
perk-beast-friend.description: Animals trust them: more encounters, easier taming (+5 Survival).

perk-iron-stomach.name: Iron stomach
perk-iron-stomach.description: Hunger grows half as fast, and bad berries do no harm (+5 Endurance).

perk-climber.name: Climber
perk-climber.description: Climbs any cliff without a rope (+5 Athletics).

perk-night-eyes.name: Night eyes
perk-night-eyes.description: Sees in the dark as in daylight (+5 Perception).

perk-crowd-favourite.name: Crowd favourite
perk-crowd-favourite.description: The spectators love them: gifts and help come more often (+5 Persuasion).

perk-tracker.name: Tracker
perk-tracker.description: Reads every trail: better hunts, and relics found sooner (+5 Survival, +5 Perception).

item-spear.description: Keeps foes at a distance and catches fish (damage 6).

item-crossbow.description: Slow to load, hard to stop (ranged, damage 7).

item-throwing-knives.description: A handful of quick blades (ranged, damage 4).

item-rope.description: Gets you out of pits and up walls (+5 Athletics).

item-flint.description: Lights fires: warmth, cooking, and beasts kept at bay (+5 Survival).

item-bird-call.description: Mimics animals, a great help to tame them (+3 Perception).

item-waterskin.description: Fresh water for the hot days (+5 Endurance).

item-grappling-hook.description: Climbs walls and crosses chasms (+5 Athletics).

event-find-chapel.success: Searching a ruined chapel, {a} finds {item} under a toppled statue of a forgotten saint.
event-find-chapel.failure: {a} searches a ruined chapel for an hour and finds only pigeons, who are not pleased.

event-find-chest.success: {a} spots a chest half buried in the moss and pries out {item}.
event-find-chest.failure: {a} digs up a promising chest. It is full of very old socks.

event-find-camp.success: {a} comes across an abandoned camp, still warm, and leaves with {item}.
event-find-camp.failure: {a} finds an abandoned camp, but someone was faster: only ashes remain.

event-find-tree.success: {a} climbs an ancient oak to reach a bundle caught in its branches: {item}.
event-find-tree.failure: {a} tries to climb an ancient oak, slips twice and decides that whatever is up there can stay there.

event-find-river.success: {a} fishes a waterlogged satchel out of the river. Inside: {item}.
event-find-river.failure: {a} wades into the river after a floating satchel and comes back with nothing but wet boots.

event-find-armoury.success: Under cover of darkness, {a} slips into the arena's old armoury and takes {item}.
event-find-armoury.failure: {a} tries to sneak into the old armoury, knocks over a rack of shields and flees in a terrible clatter.

event-find-lantern-night.success: Despite the darkness, {a} notices a glint between two rocks: {item}.
event-find-lantern-night.failure: {a} gropes around in the dark for a glint seen at dusk and finds only a very surprised toad.

event-gift-sky.only: A small parachute drifts down from the sky and lands at the feet of {a}: {item}, with a note saying "Good luck!"

event-forage-berries.success: {a} finds a thicket of blackberries and eats until {{a:his|her|their}} fingers are purple.
event-forage-berries.failure: {a} eats a handful of bright red berries. The rest of the afternoon is spent regretting it.

event-forage-hunt.success: {a} brings down a hare with a single shot and roasts it over a small fire.
event-forage-hunt.failure: {a} spends the morning chasing a hare. The hare wins.

event-forage-fish.success: {a} catches three fat trout with bare hands and a lot of patience.
event-forage-fish.failure: {a} tries to catch fish with bare hands and falls in the stream. The fish seem amused.

event-forage-mushrooms.success: {a} recognises a ring of edible mushrooms and makes a surprisingly good soup.
event-forage-mushrooms.failure: {a} eats a pretty blue mushroom and spends an hour discussing philosophy with a tree.

event-forage-spring.success: {a} follows the sound of water to a clear spring and drinks deeply.
event-forage-spring.failure: {a} drinks from a muddy puddle out of thirst. It was not a good idea.

event-hazard-pit.success: {a} notices loose branches on the path just in time and steps around a deep pit trap.
event-hazard-pit.failure: {a} falls into a pit trap and needs a long, painful time to climb back out.
event-hazard-pit.defeated: {a} falls into a deep pit trap and cannot climb out; at nightfall, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-quicksand.success: {a} sinks into quicksand up to the knees, but pulls free with a mighty effort.
event-hazard-quicksand.failure: {a} gets out of the quicksand, exhausted and covered in mud.
event-hazard-quicksand.lost: {a} escapes the quicksand, but {theItem} is swallowed by the mud.
event-hazard-quicksand.defeated: {a} is caught in quicksand up to the chest; the arena wardens carry {a} away, unconscious.

event-hazard-rockslide.success: A rockslide thunders down the slope; {a} dives aside just in time.
event-hazard-rockslide.failure: A rockslide catches {a}, who limps away bruised and dusty.
event-hazard-rockslide.defeated: A rockslide buries {a} up to the shoulders; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-bees.success: {a} disturbs a wild beehive and outruns the whole swarm, waving both arms.
event-hazard-bees.failure: {a} disturbs a wild beehive. The bees have opinions, and share them at length.
event-hazard-bees.defeated: {a} is chased by a furious swarm of bees into the river; the arena wardens carry {a} away, very swollen.

event-hazard-cold.success: The night is freezing, but {a} curls up under a rock and holds on until dawn.
event-hazard-cold.failure: The night is freezing and {a} shivers until dawn without a wink of sleep.
event-hazard-cold.defeated: The cold is too much for {a}; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {a} away, wrapped in a blanket.

event-hazard-runes.success: {a} recognises warding runes carved on an archway and walks around it. Wise choice.
event-hazard-runes.failure: {a} walks under an archway carved with runes, which go off in a flash of blue fire.
event-hazard-runes.defeated: {a} triggers a rune trap and is thrown across the clearing; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-snake.success: {a} spots a viper coiled in the grass and gives it a very respectful berth.
event-hazard-snake.failure: A viper bites {a}, who spends a feverish hour sucking out the venom.
event-hazard-snake.defeated: A viper bites {a}; the fever comes fast, and the arena wardens carry {a} away to the healers.

event-hazard-river.success: {a} crosses a fast river from stone to stone without even wetting a boot.
event-hazard-river.failure: {a} slips crossing the river and is carried downstream before reaching the bank.
event-hazard-river.lost: {a} slips crossing the river; the current carries away {theItem}.
event-hazard-river.defeated: {a} is swept away by the river; the arena wardens carry {a} away far downstream.

event-rest-cave.only: {a} finds a dry cave and sleeps soundly for the first time since the start.

event-rest-tree.only: {a} ties {{a:himself|herself|themself}} to a high branch and sleeps above the arena, out of reach.

event-quiet-song.only: {a} sings an old song to keep up {{a:his|her|their}} courage. Somewhere in the dark, someone hums along.

event-quiet-sharpen.only: {a} spends a quiet hour sharpening, polishing and admiring {{a:his|her|their}} gear.

event-quiet-stars.only: {a} lies on {{a:his|her|their}} back and counts the stars, wondering how it all came to this.

event-quiet-squirrel.only: {a} has a long conversation with a squirrel. The squirrel makes some excellent points.

event-quiet-practice.only: {a} practises alone in a clearing, striking at shadows until the moves feel right.

event-quiet-watch.only: {a} keeps watch all night with {{a:his|her|their}} back to a rock. Nothing comes. That is almost worse.

event-potion.only: {a} uses {theItem}; the wounds close and the colour comes back.

event-treat.success: {a} cleans and binds {{a:his|her|their}} wounds with steady hands.
event-treat.failure: {a} tries to bandage a wound and makes it worse. Bandaging is harder than it looks.

event-arena-mist.success: A grey mist rolls over the arena, heavy and choking; {a} holds {{a:his|her|their}} breath and pushes through.
event-arena-mist.failure: A choking mist rolls over the arena and {a} comes out coughing, eyes streaming.
event-arena-mist.defeated: The choking mist swallows {a}; when it lifts, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-arena-fire.success: A wall of magical fire sweeps across the arena; {a} sprints ahead of it and makes it out.
event-arena-fire.failure: A wall of magical fire sweeps across the arena and singes {a}, who smells of roast for the rest of the day.
event-arena-fire.defeated: The wall of fire cuts off every path for {a}; the arena wardens carry {a} away through a hidden door.

event-arena-storm.success: A storm summoned by the arena masters breaks overhead; {a} weathers it under a ledge.
event-arena-storm.failure: The arena masters summon a storm, and a bolt of lightning lands far too close to {a}.
event-arena-storm.defeated: Lightning strikes right next to {a}; dazed and smoking, {a} is carried out by the wardens.

event-arena-beast.success: The masters release a manticore into the arena. {a} fights it off and it slinks away, sulking.
event-arena-beast.failure: A manticore released by the masters catches {a}, who escapes with a few scratches and a deep dislike of manticores.
event-arena-beast.defeated: A manticore corners {a}; the wardens drive it back with torches and carry {a} out of the arena.

event-arena-walls.success: With a grinding of stone, the arena walls move closer; {a} scrambles over the rubble in time.
event-arena-walls.failure: The arena walls move closer and {a} is caught by falling stones while running.
event-arena-walls.defeated: The moving walls trap {a} in a dead end; the arena wardens carry {a} away through the gate.

event-fight-clearing.win: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {a} lands the better blows and {b} retreats into the trees.
event-fight-clearing.lose: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {b} is quicker, and {a} has to flee, wounded.
event-fight-clearing.draw: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. Neither gives an inch; they part, panting, promising to finish it later.
event-fight-clearing.defeat: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {a} wins the duel; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-clearing.defeated: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {b} wins the duel; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-bridge.win: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {a} forces {b} back to the far side.
event-fight-bridge.lose: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {b} forces {a} back the way {{a:he|she|they}} came.
event-fight-bridge.draw: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. The bridge sways so much that they both decide to go round instead.
event-fight-bridge.defeat: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {b} loses the fight and the footing, and splashes into the river below; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-bridge.defeated: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {a} loses the fight and the footing, and splashes into the river below; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-night.win: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. {a} strikes true, and {b} vanishes into the night, hurt.
event-fight-night.lose: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. {b} strikes true, and {a} vanishes into the night, hurt.
event-fight-night.draw: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. They fight blind for a while, then lose each other in the darkness.
event-fight-night.defeat: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. When the moon comes out, {b} is down; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-night.defeated: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. When the moon comes out, {a} is down; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-brawl.win: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {a} keeps the bread and most of {{a:his|her|their}} teeth.
event-fight-brawl.lose: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {b} keeps the bread; {a} keeps a black eye.
event-fight-brawl.draw: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. The bread is trampled in the fight. Nobody wins.
event-fight-brawl.defeat: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {a} wins the brawl and the bread; the arena wardens carry {b} away, still hungry.
event-fight-brawl.defeated: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {b} wins the brawl and the bread; the arena wardens carry {a} away, still hungry.

event-fight-arrows.win: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. The shot finds its mark; {b} dives behind the rocks, wounded.
event-fight-arrows.lose: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. {b} shoots back faster, and {a} has to take cover, wounded.
event-fight-arrows.draw: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. They trade shots until both run out of patience.
event-fight-arrows.defeat: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. The arrow strikes home; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-arrows.defeated: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. {b} shoots first and better; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-spells.win: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. The spell hits {b} full on, and {b} runs off with smoking clothes.
event-fight-spells.lose: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. The spell backfires and singes {a}'s eyebrows; {b} takes the chance to strike.
event-fight-spells.draw: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. Sparks fly, the grass catches fire, and both have to run.
event-fight-spells.defeat: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. A blinding flash, and {b} is down; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-spells.defeated: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. {b} breaks the spell and answers in kind; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-ruins.win: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {a} drives {b} out of the ruins.
event-fight-ruins.lose: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {b} drives {a} out of the ruins.
event-fight-ruins.draw: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. A wall collapses between them, and the fight ends there.
event-fight-ruins.defeat: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {a} has the last word; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-ruins.defeated: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {b} has the last word; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-mud.win: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {a} comes out on top, muddy but proud.
event-fight-mud.lose: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {b} comes out on top; {a} crawls away, muddy and humbled.
event-fight-mud.draw: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. Nobody can tell who is who under the mud. They give up.
event-fight-mud.defeat: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {a} pins {b} in the mud; the arena wardens carry {b} away, dripping.
event-fight-mud.defeated: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {b} pins {a} in the mud; the arena wardens carry {a} away, dripping.

event-ambush-bushes.success: {a} waits in the bushes and leaps out on {b}, who never saw it coming.
event-ambush-bushes.defeat: {a} ambushes {b} from the bushes; it is over in a moment, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-bushes.failure: {a} tries to ambush {b}, but sneezes at the wrong moment.
event-ambush-bushes.defeated: {a} tries to ambush {b}, who was expecting it; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-ambush-night.success: {a} creeps up on {b}'s camp in the dark and strikes before vanishing again.
event-ambush-night.defeat: {a} creeps up on {b} while {b} sleeps; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-night.failure: {a} creeps up on {b} in the dark and steps on a very loud twig.
event-ambush-night.defeated: {a} creeps up on {b}, who was only pretending to sleep; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-social-intimidate.success: {a} stares {b} down with a growl until {b} decides to be somewhere else.
event-social-intimidate.took: {a} glares at {b} so fiercely that {b} drops {item} and runs.
event-social-intimidate.failure: {a} tries to frighten {b}, who laughs and throws a stone at {{a:his|her|their}} head.

event-social-spare.success: Cornered by {b}, {a} talks so well about honour and the long road ahead that {b} lets {{a:him|her|them}} go.
event-social-spare.failure: Cornered by {b}, {a} tries to talk the way out. {b} is not in a talking mood.

event-social-trap.success: {a} pretends to have found treasure by a cliff. {b} goes to look and tumbles down the slope.
event-social-trap.defeat: {a} lures {b} onto a crumbling ledge with a tall tale; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-social-trap.failure: {a} tells {b} a story about hidden treasure. {b} has heard that one before.

event-social-bluff.success: {a} convinces {b} that a whole army is hiding behind the hill. {b} runs.
event-social-bluff.took: {a} convinces {b} that {item} is cursed. {b} drops it and {a} picks it up, unbothered.
event-social-bluff.failure: {a} claims to have an army behind the hill. {b} looks. There is no army.

event-social-riddle.success: {a} challenges {b} to a riddle contest and wins it with a question about wind.
event-social-riddle.took: {a} wins a riddle contest against {b}, and the prize: {item}.
event-social-riddle.failure: {a} challenges {b} to a riddle contest and loses to a question about cheese.

event-social-taunt.success: {a} shouts insults at {b} from a hilltop, so creative that {b} leaves to think about them.
event-social-taunt.failure: {a} shouts insults at {b}, who answers with better ones. {a} is wounded in {{a:his|her|their}} pride.

event-steal-camp.success: While {b} sleeps, {a} sneaks into the camp and leaves with {item}.
event-steal-camp.failure: {a} tries to steal from {b}'s camp and gets a boot thrown at {{a:his|her|their}} head.

event-steal-pickpocket.success: {a} bumps into {b}, apologises warmly, and walks away with {item}.
event-steal-pickpocket.failure: {a} bumps into {b} to pick a pocket; {b} checks every pocket and glares.

event-finish.win: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} is hit again but limps away.
event-finish.lose: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} finds the strength to fight back and drives {a} off.
event-finish.draw: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} slips away before {a} can strike again.
event-finish.defeat: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {a} finishes what was started; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-finish.defeated: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. Cornered, {b} fights back like a lion; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-spare.only: {a} finds {b} wounded and defenceless, and walks away. "Not like this."

event-finale-duel.defeat: Before the whole arena, {a} and {b} fight until one of them cannot rise; it is {b}, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-finale-duel.defeated: Before the whole arena, {a} and {b} fight until one of them cannot rise; it is {a}, and the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-finale-honour.defeat: {a} and {b} salute each other before a duel of honour. When {b} falls to one knee, {a} offers a hand; {b} takes it, smiles, and walks out of the arena.
event-finale-honour.defeated: {a} and {b} salute each other before a duel of honour. When {a} falls to one knee, {b} offers a hand; {a} takes it, smiles, and walks out of the arena.

event-team-heal.success: {a} tends to {b}'s wounds by the fire. By morning, {b} is back on {{b:his|her|their}} feet.
event-team-heal.failure: {a} tries to tend to {b}'s wounds, but there is little to be done without proper herbs.

event-team-heal-song.success: {a} hums an old healing song over {b}; the pain fades with each verse.
event-team-heal-song.failure: {a} sings a healing song for {b}. It does not heal, but it is a lovely song.

event-share-food.only: {a} shares {{a:his|her|their}} last rations with {b}. Neither will admit how hungry they are.

event-banter-plan.only: {a} and {b} spend the evening drawing plans in the dirt. The plans get more ambitious with every hour.

event-banter-joke.only: {a} tells {b} a joke so bad that {b} laughs for ten minutes. Somewhere, a rival hears and wonders.

event-banter-watch.only: {a} keeps watch so that {b} can sleep. Then they swap. Nobody sneaks up on them tonight.

event-trade.only: {a} gives {item} to {b}: "You will need it more than I do."

event-alliance-offer.success: {a} lowers {{a:his|her|their}} weapon and offers {b} an alliance. After a long silence, {b} shakes on it.
event-alliance-offer.failure: {a} offers {b} an alliance. {b} answers by backing away slowly, never turning around.

event-alliance-fire.success: Freezing, {b} approaches the fire of {a}, who makes room. By morning, they are allies.
event-alliance-fire.failure: {b} approaches the fire of {a}, who throws a pinecone in warning. The message is clear.

event-split-argument.only: Old grudges catch up with {a} and {b}. After a bitter argument, {a} walks away from the team for good.

event-split-share.only: {a} catches {b} hiding food from the team. That was the last straw: {a} goes alone from now on.

event-betray-sleep.success: While {b} sleeps, {a} breaks their alliance with a treacherous blow, and is gone before dawn.
event-betray-sleep.defeat: {a} waits until {b} is asleep and ends their alliance in the cruellest way; the arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-betray-back.success: {a} smiles at {b}, then strikes. "Nothing personal. It's the arena."
event-betray-back.defeat: {a} turns on {b} without warning. "Nothing personal." The arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-protect.success: {c} goes for the wounded {b}, but {a} steps in between and drives {c} back.
event-protect.failure: {a} throws {{a:himself|herself|themself}} between {b} and {c}, and takes the blows meant for {b}.
event-protect.defeat: {a} rushes to protect {b} from {c}, and wins; the arena wardens carry {c} away.
event-protect.defeated: {a} stands between {b} and {c} to the very end; the arena wardens carry {a} away, but {b} is safe.

event-protect-leader.success: "Behind me!" {a} shields {b} and faces {c}, who thinks better of it.
event-protect-leader.failure: "Behind me!" {a} shields {b} from {c} and pays for it with a few wounds.
event-protect-leader.defeat: "Behind me!" {a} leads the defence of {b} against {c} and wins; the arena wardens carry {c} away.
event-protect-leader.defeated: "Behind me!" {a} holds {c} off long enough for {b} to escape; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-sacrifice.only: When {c} closes in on the wounded {b}, {a} takes the blow instead and falls. The arena wardens carry {a} out, while {b} gets away.

event-team-camp.only: {a} and {b} build a hidden camp under the roots of a fallen tree, and take turns sleeping.

event-team-scout.only: {a} scouts ahead while {b} watches their backs. They move through the arena like a single shadow.

event-team-oath.only: By the fire, {a} and {b} renew an old promise: whatever happens, they leave this arena together.

event-team-heal-herbs.success: {a} gathers silverleaf and makes a poultice for {b}. It stings, it smells, and it works.
event-team-heal-herbs.failure: {a} gathers herbs for {b}, but picks the wrong ones. At least they smell nice.

event-share-water.only: {a} finds a spring and fills both flasks, the one for {b} first.

event-alliance-enemy.success: {a} and {b} have been chased by the same rival all day. By evening, they agree to face the threat together.
event-alliance-enemy.failure: {a} suggests to {b} that they team up against a common rival. {b} suspects a trap, and walks away.

event-betray-draught.success: {a} offers {b} a cup of herbal tea laced with a sleeping draught, then slips away with a quiet "sorry".
event-betray-draught.defeat: {a} slips a sleeping draught into the cup of {b}; the arena wardens carry {b} away, snoring.

event-split-chaotic.only: {a} announces to {b} that teamwork is overrated and wanders off whistling.

event-prank.success: {a} fills the boots of {b} with pinecones during the night. {b} spends the morning limping and swearing.
event-prank.failure: {a} tries to fill the boots of {b} with pinecones and is caught red-handed.

event-fight-stream.win: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. {a} reacts first and chases {b} downstream.
event-fight-stream.lose: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. {b} reacts first and chases {a} downstream.
event-fight-stream.draw: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. They splash at each other for a while, then both retreat, soaked.
event-fight-stream.defeat: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. The fight is short and splashy; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-stream.defeated: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. The fight is short and splashy; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-cave.win: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. {a} wins the cave; {b} spends the night outside, nursing a bruise.
event-fight-cave.lose: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. {b} keeps the cave; {a} spends the night outside, nursing a bruise.
event-fight-cave.draw: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. After a long scuffle in the dark, they grudgingly sleep at opposite ends.
event-fight-cave.defeat: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. The cave echoes with the fight; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-cave.defeated: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. The cave echoes with the fight; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-honour.win: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {a} has the upper hand, and lets {b} step back with dignity, still in the arena.
event-fight-honour.lose: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {b} has the upper hand, and {a} withdraws with a nod of respect.
event-fight-honour.draw: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." The duel is perfectly even. They part with a salute.
event-fight-honour.defeat: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {a} wins the duel of honour; {b} yields, and the arena wardens carry {b} out with respect.
event-fight-honour.defeated: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {b} wins the duel of honour; {a} yields, and the arena wardens carry {a} out with respect.

event-fight-spells-night.win: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. Dazzled, {b} stumbles away into the night.
event-fight-spells-night.lose: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. {b} shields {{b:his|her|their}} eyes and charges; {a} has to flee, scorched by the backlash.
event-fight-spells-night.draw: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. The spell lights up the whole arena, and both decide to hide before anyone else comes.
event-fight-spells-night.defeat: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. A second spell finishes the duel; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-spells-night.defeated: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. {b} strikes before the second spell; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-sling.win: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. The shot hits home, and {b} runs zigzagging for the trees.
event-fight-sling.lose: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. {b} dodges and shoots back; {a} has to leave the rock in a hurry.
event-fight-sling.draw: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. Every shot misses. Both pretend they meant to.
event-fight-sling.defeat: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. The shot is perfect; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-sling.defeated: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. {b} shoots back, and better; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-ambush-tree.success: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}, strikes, and is gone before {b} understands what happened.
event-ambush-tree.defeat: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}; it is over at once, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-tree.failure: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}, misses, and lands in a bush. {b} laughs on the way out.
event-ambush-tree.defeated: {a} drops from a tree, straight onto the raised weapon of {b}; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-find-statue.success: {a} reads the old inscription on a statue, presses the right stone, and a hidden niche opens: {item}.
event-find-statue.failure: {a} presses every stone of an old statue. One of them was a wasp nest.

event-hazard-wolves.success: A pack of wolves circles the camp of {a}, who waves a burning branch until they leave.
event-hazard-wolves.failure: Wolves attack {a} in the night; it takes a long fight to drive them off.
event-hazard-wolves.defeated: A pack of wolves corners {a}; the wardens drive them off with horns and torches, and carry {a} out of the arena.

event-hazard-thorns.success: {a} finds a way through a field of thornbushes without a single scratch.
event-hazard-thorns.failure: {a} tries to cut through a field of thornbushes and comes out looking like a pincushion.
event-hazard-thorns.defeated: {a} gets hopelessly tangled in a field of enchanted thorns; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-quiet-letter.only: By the light of a small fire, {a} writes a letter home, in case. Then tears it up, out of stubbornness.

event-quiet-crowd.only: {a} climbs onto a rock and bows to the invisible crowd. Somewhere, the arena masters are applauding.

event-rest-spring.only: {a} finds a hot spring hidden between the rocks, and soaks until every ache is gone.

event-couple-fire.only: Under the stars, {a} and {b} finally say what everyone had guessed: they will leave the arena together, or not at all. They leave their old companions to face it side by side.

event-couple-rescue.only: {a} pulls {b} out of harm's way for the second time today. This time, neither lets go of the other's hand. From now on, they fight as one.

event-couple-dance.only: The arena drums beat in the distance. {a} offers {b} a clumsy bow, and they dance in the ruins until dawn. By morning, they are a team of two.

event-couple-oath.only: {a} and {b} carve their initials into an old oak, then argue about whose letters are crooked.

event-couple-watch.only: {a} keeps watch while {b} sleeps, and pretends not to have been watching {b} rather than the shadows.

event-couple-plans.only: {a} and {b} plan their life after the arena: a farm, two goats, and absolutely no more fighting.

event-jealousy-glare.only: {a} watches {b} walk away with someone else, and remembers every campfire they once shared as a team.

event-jealousy-words.only: {a} crosses paths with {b}. "You left us for that?" The silence that follows is worse than any blow.

event-protect-partner.success: {c} goes for {b}, and meets {a} instead, eyes blazing. {c} decides there are easier targets.
event-protect-partner.failure: {a} throws {{a:himself|herself|themself}} in front of {b} and takes the blows {c} meant for {b}.
event-protect-partner.defeat: Nobody touches {b}: {a} fights {c} with a fury the arena has rarely seen, and the arena wardens carry {c} away.
event-protect-partner.defeated: {a} holds {c} off long enough for {b} to escape; the arena wardens carry {a} away, smiling.

event-sacrifice-partner.only: When {c} lands the blow meant for {b}, it is {a} who takes it. The wardens carry {a} out of the arena; {b} walks on alone, with a promise to keep.

event-revenge-hunt.win: {a} has not forgotten what {b} did. After a long hunt, {a} finally catches up. {a} gets some of the revenge owed, and {b} flees.
event-revenge-hunt.lose: {a} has not forgotten what {b} did. After a long hunt, {a} finally catches up. {b} turns the hunt around, and {a} has to run.
event-revenge-hunt.draw: {a} has not forgotten what {b} did. After a long hunt, {a} finally catches up. The old wound stays open: neither can finish it today.
event-revenge-hunt.defeat: {a} has not forgotten what {b} did. After a long hunt, {a} finally catches up. {a} settles the score; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-revenge-hunt.defeated: {a} has not forgotten what {b} did. After a long hunt, {a} finally catches up. Revenge turns sour: the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-revenge-duel.win: {a} calls out to {b} across the clearing: "You and me. Now." {a} wins the round, and the grudge feels a little lighter.
event-revenge-duel.lose: {a} calls out to {b} across the clearing: "You and me. Now." {b} wins again, and the grudge grows heavier.
event-revenge-duel.draw: {a} calls out to {b} across the clearing: "You and me. Now." They fight to a standstill, and swear it is not over.
event-revenge-duel.defeat: {a} calls out to {b} across the clearing: "You and me. Now." The grudge ends here: the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-revenge-duel.defeated: {a} calls out to {b} across the clearing: "You and me. Now." The grudge ends badly: the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-avenge-friend.win: {a} finds {b}, who took a companion out of the arena. "This is for them." {a} strikes hard, and {b} retreats, shaken.
event-avenge-friend.lose: {a} finds {b}, who took a companion out of the arena. "This is for them." Anger is not enough: {b} drives {a} away.
event-avenge-friend.draw: {a} finds {b}, who took a companion out of the arena. "This is for them." The fight ends with no winner, and the debt still unpaid.
event-avenge-friend.defeat: {a} finds {b}, who took a companion out of the arena. "This is for them." The fallen are avenged: the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-avenge-friend.defeated: {a} finds {b}, who took a companion out of the arena. "This is for them." {a} joins the fallen companion: the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-avenge-night.win: {a} spends the night tracking {b} by the light of the moon, for the sake of a fallen friend. At dawn, {a} lands a blow, and {b} disappears into the mist.
event-avenge-night.lose: {a} spends the night tracking {b} by the light of the moon, for the sake of a fallen friend. At dawn, {b} is waiting, and {a} is the one who has to flee.
event-avenge-night.draw: {a} spends the night tracking {b} by the light of the moon, for the sake of a fallen friend. The trail goes cold in the night.
event-avenge-night.defeat: {a} spends the night tracking {b} by the light of the moon, for the sake of a fallen friend. By dawn, the debt is paid: the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-avenge-night.defeated: {a} spends the night tracking {b} by the light of the moon, for the sake of a fallen friend. By dawn, the hunter has become the prey: the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-reconcile-words.success: {a} sits down by the fire of {b}, and they talk until the old grudge burns out with the logs.
event-reconcile-words.failure: {a} tries to make peace with {b}, who answers by turning away.

event-reconcile-gift.success: {a} leaves a peace offering on a rock where {b} will find it. The next time they meet, nobody draws a weapon.
event-reconcile-gift.failure: {a} leaves a peace offering for {b}, who kicks it into the river.

event-melee-chest.none: A golden chest falls from the sky. {all} rush at it, and in the confusion the chest rolls into a ravine. Nobody gets it.
event-melee-chest.hurt: A golden chest falls from the sky, and {all} fight over it. Bruises for {hurt}; in the end, {looter} runs off with what was inside: {item}.
event-melee-chest.defeat: A golden chest falls from the sky, and {all} fight over it. When the dust settles, the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena, and {looter} opens the chest: {item}.

event-melee-ruins.none: In the dark ruins, {all} stumble into each other. After a lot of shouting, everyone runs in a different direction.
event-melee-ruins.hurt: In the dark ruins, {all} fight blindly. By dawn, {hurt} bear the marks.
event-melee-ruins.defeat: In the dark ruins, {all} fight blindly. By dawn, the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-melee-spring.none: {all} reach the only spring at the same time. A long, tense standoff follows, and everyone drinks in turn, glaring.
event-melee-spring.hurt: {all} reach the only spring at the same time, and it turns into a brawl. {hurt} leave soaked and bruised.
event-melee-spring.defeat: {all} reach the only spring at the same time, and it turns into a brawl; the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-gang-team.defeat: {others} surround {a} without a word. It is over quickly, and the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-gang-team.escape: {others} surround {a}, who slips between them and vanishes into the undergrowth.

event-gang-night.defeat: {others} fall on the camp of {a} in the middle of the night; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-gang-night.escape: {others} fall on the camp of {a} in the middle of the night, but find only a dummy made of branches.

event-gang-coalition.defeat: {a} has defeated too many. {others} put their quarrels aside to bring {a} down, and the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-gang-coalition.escape: {others} join forces against {a}, the most feared contestant. They fail, but the alliance holds.

event-group-bridge.safe: The bridge under {all} gives way; everyone leaps to safety at the last moment.
event-group-bridge.hurt: The bridge under {all} gives way. A cold bath and a few bruises for {hurt}.
event-group-bridge.defeat: The bridge under {all} gives way, and the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-group-flood.safe: A flood rushes through the valley where {all} are camping. Everyone climbs a tree in time.
event-group-flood.hurt: A flood rushes through the valley where {all} are camping; the current sweeps away {hurt} for a while.
event-group-flood.defeat: A flood rushes through the valley where {all} are camping, and the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-group-mist.safe: A poisoned mist rolls over {all}, who hold their breath and get through it.
event-group-mist.hurt: A poisoned mist rolls over {all}; coughing fits for {hurt}.
event-group-mist.defeat: A poisoned mist rolls over {all}, and the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-group-rockfall.safe: Rocks rain down on {all}; everyone spots them in time and dives for cover.
event-group-rockfall.hurt: Rocks rain down on {all}; a few hit {hurt}.
event-group-rockfall.defeat: Rocks rain down on {all}, and the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena.

event-feast-truce.only: Rain falls hard, and {all} end up sharing the same cave. For one night, a truce: soup, stories, and nobody sleeps with a hand on a weapon. Almost nobody.

event-feast-banquet.only: The arena masters set up a banquet in a clearing, and {all} are invited. Roast boar, honey cakes, and many suspicious looks across the table.

event-feast-song.only: Around one big fire, {all} sing the same old song in different languages. Nobody admits enjoying it.

event-melee-crate.none: A crate of supplies lands in the night. {all} circle it warily until dawn, and by then the arena masters have taken it back.
event-melee-crate.hurt: A crate of supplies lands in the night, and {all} fight over it in the dark. Bruises for {hurt}; {looter} drags the crate away and finds {item} inside.
event-melee-crate.defeat: A crate of supplies lands in the night, and {all} fight over it in the dark; the arena wardens carry {fallen} out of the arena, and {looter} keeps the crate: {item}.

event-scavenge-camp.only: {a} comes across the deserted camp of a contestant who is out of the arena, and picks up what was left behind: {item}.

event-scavenge-night.only: By moonlight, {a} searches the place of an old fight and finds {item} in the grass.

event-scavenge-trade.only: {a} haggles with a wandering arena servant, who sells off the belongings of the fallen. {a} leaves with {item}.

event-find-cache.success: {a} notices freshly turned earth under a tree and digs up a hidden cache: {item}.
event-find-cache.failure: {a} digs under a tree for an hour, and finds a very old, very angry badger.

event-quiet-memory.only: {a} turns a small keepsake over and over in the firelight, and thinks of home.

event-tool-cliff.success: The only way on is down a sheer cliff. {a} climbs down by the cracks, slowly, and makes it.
event-tool-cliff.failure: The only way on is down a sheer cliff. {a} slips halfway and slides the rest of the way down, scraped raw.
event-tool-cliff.defeated: The only way on is down a sheer cliff. {a} falls from high up; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-cliff.tool: The only way on is down a sheer cliff. {a} ties {theItem} to a tree and abseils down without a scratch.
event-tool-cliff.knack: The only way on is down a sheer cliff. {a} climbs down it like a staircase, whistling.

event-tool-chasm.success: A chasm cuts the path. {a} takes a run-up and jumps; the far edge crumbles, but holds.
event-tool-chasm.failure: A chasm cuts the path. {a} jumps, falls short, and hangs by the fingertips before scrambling up, bleeding.
event-tool-chasm.defeated: A chasm cuts the path. {a} jumps and does not reach the other side; the arena wardens carry {a} away from the bottom.
event-tool-chasm.tool: A chasm cuts the path. {a} throws {theItem} around a stump on the other side and crosses hand over hand.
event-tool-chasm.knack: A chasm cuts the path. {a} climbs down one wall and up the other as if it were nothing.

event-tool-well.success: {a} leans over an old well to look for water, loses balance, and catches the rim just in time.
event-tool-well.failure: {a} falls into an old well, and needs an hour of painful climbing to get out.
event-tool-well.defeated: {a} falls into an old well and cannot climb out; the arena wardens carry {a} away the next morning.
event-tool-well.tool: {a} lowers {theItem} into an old well, climbs down, drinks, and comes back up refreshed.
event-tool-well.knack: {a} climbs down an old well by the cracks between its stones, drinks, and climbs back up.
event-tool-well.lost: {a} falls into an old well and climbs out, but {theItem} stays at the bottom.

event-tool-cave.success: {a} feels {{a:his|her|their}} way through a pitch-black cave, finger on the wall, and comes out the other side.
event-tool-cave.failure: {a} crosses a pitch-black cave and bangs into every rock in it.
event-tool-cave.defeated: {a} falls down a hole in a pitch-black cave; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-cave.tool: {a} lights {theItem} and crosses a deep cave, stepping around the holes in the floor.
event-tool-cave.knack: {a} crosses a pitch-black cave as easily as a meadow at noon: those eyes see in the dark.

event-tool-mine.success: {a} shelters in an old mine and reads the props: this gallery is safe, that one is not.
event-tool-mine.failure: {a} shelters in an old mine; part of the ceiling comes down in the night.
event-tool-mine.defeated: {a} shelters in an old mine, which caves in; the arena wardens carry {a} away at dawn.
event-tool-mine.tool: By the light of {theItem}, {a} explores an old mine and finds a dry, safe corner to sleep.
event-tool-mine.knack: {a} explores an old mine without a light, spots the rotten props, and sleeps in the one safe gallery.

event-tool-cage.success: A net drops from the trees and drags {a} into a hanging cage; {a} bends the bars and squeezes out.
event-tool-cage.failure: A net drops from the trees and drags {a} into a hanging cage, where {a} stays until dawn, hungry and stiff.
event-tool-cage.defeated: A net drops from the trees and drags {a} into a hanging cage; the arena masters leave the cage shut. The arena wardens carry {a} away, cage and all.
event-tool-cage.tool: A net drops from the trees and drags {a} into a hanging cage; {theItem} opens the lock in a few seconds.

event-tool-vines.success: Thorny vines close around {a}, who tears free by sheer strength.
event-tool-vines.failure: Thorny vines close around {a}; getting out leaves long scratches everywhere.
event-tool-vines.defeated: Thorny vines close around {a} and tighten until the wardens cut {{a:him|her|them}} loose; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-vines.tool: Thorny vines close around {a}, who cuts through them with {theItem} in three strokes.

event-tool-arrows.success: A tripwire sets off a volley of arrows; {a} throws {{a:himself|herself|themself}} flat in time.
event-tool-arrows.failure: A tripwire sets off a volley of arrows; one of them grazes {a}.
event-tool-arrows.defeated: A tripwire sets off a volley of arrows that leaves {a} on the ground; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-arrows.tool: A tripwire sets off a volley of arrows; they all thud into {theItem}, raised just in time by {a}.

event-tool-cold.success: A freezing wind sweeps the arena; {a} shivers all night but holds on.
event-tool-cold.failure: A freezing wind sweeps the arena; {a} wakes up numb, with blue fingers.
event-tool-cold.defeated: A freezing wind sweeps the arena; at dawn, {a} cannot get up, and the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-cold.tool: A freezing wind sweeps the arena; wrapped in {theItem}, {a} sleeps like a log.

event-tool-maze.success: {a} wanders into a hedge maze and finds the way out by keeping one hand on the wall.
event-tool-maze.failure: {a} wanders into a hedge maze and spends the whole day in it, thirsty.
event-tool-maze.defeated: {a} never finds the way out of a hedge maze; the arena wardens carry {a} away at nightfall.
event-tool-maze.tool: {a} unfolds {theItem}, finds the hedge maze drawn on it, and walks straight through.

event-tool-poison.success: {a} almost eats a handful of pretty berries, then recognises them: deadly nightshade.
event-tool-poison.failure: {a} eats a handful of berries and spends hours being sick.
event-tool-poison.defeated: {a} eats a handful of poisonous berries; the arena wardens carry {a} away, pale as a sheet.
event-tool-poison.tool: {a} eats poisonous berries, feels the cramps start, and drinks {theItem} just in time.
event-tool-poison.knack: {a} eats a handful of poisonous berries, burps, and asks for more.

event-tool-smoke.success: {a} stumbles into a camp of arena guards on patrol and slips away before being seen.
event-tool-smoke.failure: {a} stumbles into a camp of arena guards, who chase {{a:him|her|them}} off with sticks.
event-tool-smoke.defeated: {a} stumbles into a camp of arena guards, who decide this contestant has had enough; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-smoke.tool: {a} stumbles into a camp of arena guards, throws {theItem}, and is gone in the smoke.
event-tool-smoke.knack: {a} stumbles into a camp of arena guards and is gone before the first one stands up.

event-tool-hunt-bow.success: {a} sets snares and catches a hare by evening.
event-tool-hunt-bow.failure: {a} sets snares all day; the hares are smarter.
event-tool-hunt-bow.tool: {a} shoots a pheasant with {theItem} and roasts it over a small fire.

event-tool-fish.success: {a} catches two fish by hand in a shallow stream.
event-tool-fish.failure: {a} spends an hour in a cold stream and catches nothing but a cold.
event-tool-fish.tool: {a} carves a fishing spear with {theItem} and has three trout by noon.

event-tool-trap-chest.success: {a} notices the needle trap on a locked chest, disarms it, and takes {item}.
event-tool-trap-chest.failure: {a} opens a chest and gets a needle in the thumb. The chest is empty, of course.

event-tame-any.success: {a} meets {animal} and spends an hour moving closer, step by step. By evening, it follows {{a:him|her|them}} everywhere.
event-tame-any.failure: {a} tries to tame {animal}, which does not want to be tamed at all; {a} gets away bitten.
event-tame-any.defeated: {a} tries to tame {animal}, which attacks; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-any.tool: {a} meets {animal} and holds out {theItem}. A friendship is born.

event-tame-wolf.success: A lone wolf circles the fire of {a} all night. At dawn, the wolf lies down at {{a:his|her|their}} feet.
event-tame-wolf.failure: A lone wolf circles the fire of {a}, who reaches out a hand too soon and gets it bitten.
event-tame-wolf.defeated: A lone wolf circles the fire of {a}, then calls its pack; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-wolf.tool: A lone wolf circles the fire of {a}, who throws it {theItem}. By dawn, they are inseparable.

event-tame-bear.success: {a} talks to a bear in a low, calm voice for a whole hour. Unbelievably, the bear listens, and stays.
event-tame-bear.failure: {a} tries talking to a bear. The bear answers with a paw; {a} flies into a bush.
event-tame-bear.defeated: {a} tries to tame a bear, a plan nobody else would have tried; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-bear.tool: {a} shares {theItem} with a hungry bear. The bear decides to stay for good.

event-tame-raven.success: {a} answers a raven in its own croaks. The bird lands on {{a:his|her|their}} shoulder and stays there.
event-tame-raven.failure: {a} croaks at a raven, which croaks back something very rude and flies off.
event-tame-raven.defeated: {a} climbs a dead tree after a raven, and the branch breaks; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-tame-hawk.success: {a} frees a hawk caught in a thorn bush. The bird circles once, then comes back to {{a:his|her|their}} arm.
event-tame-hawk.failure: {a} frees a hawk caught in a thorn bush and gets clawed for the trouble.
event-tame-hawk.defeated: {a} climbs a crag to reach a hawk's nest and falls; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-tame-hound.success: A skinny stray hound follows {a} at a distance all day. By evening, the hound has made its choice: {a} it is.
event-tame-hound.failure: A stray hound growls at {a}, who backs away a little too slowly and gets a nip on the leg.
event-tame-hound.defeated: A pack of stray hounds surrounds {a}; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-hound.tool: {a} shares {theItem} with a stray hound, who will never leave {{a:his|her|their}} side again.

event-tame-panther.success: A black panther watches {a} from a branch. {a} stays still for hours. At dawn, the panther comes down and sits beside {{a:him|her|them}}.
event-tame-panther.failure: A black panther drops from a branch next to {a}, swipes once, and vanishes.
event-tame-panther.defeated: A black panther drops from a branch onto {a}; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-tame-goat.success: {a} chases a mountain goat up the rocks for an hour. Impressed, the goat gives up and follows {{a:him|her|them}} down.
event-tame-goat.failure: {a} chases a mountain goat up the rocks and gets head-butted back down.
event-tame-goat.defeated: {a} chases a mountain goat up a cliff; the goat can climb down, {a} cannot. The arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-tame-snake.success: {a} hums an old charm to a snake, which coils around {{a:his|her|their}} arm and stays.
event-tame-snake.failure: {a} hums an old charm to a snake, which is not a music lover and bites.
event-tame-snake.defeated: {a} picks up a snake that turns out to be very venomous; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-beast-any.success: Eyes shine in the dark: {animal} prowls around {a}, who shouts and waves until it leaves.
event-beast-any.failure: {animal} attacks {a} in the dark and runs off after a few bites.
event-beast-any.defeated: {animal} attacks {a} in the dark; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-beast-any.tool: {animal} prowls around {a}, who lights {theItem}; the beast flees from the flame.

event-beast-boar.success: A boar charges {a}, who jumps aside at the last moment; the boar crashes into a tree.
event-beast-boar.failure: A boar charges {a} and sends {{a:him|her|them}} flying into the ferns.
event-beast-boar.defeated: A boar charges {a}, again and again; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-beast-bear.success: A bear sniffs the bush where {a} is hiding, then wanders off. {a} breathes again.
event-beast-bear.failure: A bear finds {a} hiding in a bush; {a} escapes, with claw marks across the back.
event-beast-bear.defeated: A bear finds {a} hiding in a bush; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-beast-snake.success: {a} spots a snake coiled under a rock just before sitting on it.
event-beast-snake.failure: A snake bites {a} on the ankle; the leg swells and throbs for hours.
event-beast-snake.defeated: A snake bites {a}, and the venom works fast; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-beast-snake.tool: A snake bites {a}, who drinks {theItem} at once and feels the venom fade.
event-beast-snake.knack: A snake bites {a}, who shrugs: it takes more than that to upset that stomach.

event-beast-wolves.success: Wolves howl close by. When one leaps at {a}, a single blow sends the whole pack away.
event-beast-wolves.failure: Wolves harass {a} all night; at dawn, {a} is covered in bites and has not slept.
event-beast-wolves.defeated: Wolves surround {a} in the night; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-companion-hunt.only: {theAnimal} comes back with something to eat and drops it at the feet of {a}. Dinner is served.

event-companion-find.only: {theAnimal} disappears for an hour and comes back empty-pawed, looking very proud of itself.
event-companion-find.found: {theAnimal} digs under a root and brings back {item} to {a}.

event-companion-warm.only: {a} sleeps curled up against {theAnimal}, warm and safe for once.

event-companion-guard.only: {theAnimal} keeps watch all night; twice, a growl warns {a} that someone is prowling.

event-companion-play.only: For an hour, {a} forgets the arena and plays with {theAnimal}. The crowd loves it.

event-companion-leave.only: {theAnimal} hears a call from the forest, looks at {a} one last time, and goes back to the wild.

event-companion-attack.success: At a whistle from {a}, {theAnimal} springs at {b}, who gets away mauled.
event-companion-attack.failure: At a whistle from {a}, {theAnimal} springs at {b}, who dodges and runs.
event-companion-attack.defeat: At a whistle from {a}, {theAnimal} springs at {b}; the arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-companion-ambush.success: In the dark, {theAnimal} creeps up on the sleeping {b} and attacks before {a} even gives the order.
event-companion-ambush.failure: In the dark, {theAnimal} creeps up on {b}, who wakes up just in time and climbs a tree.
event-companion-ambush.defeat: In the dark, {theAnimal} creeps up on {b}; when {a} arrives, it is over, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-eat-rations.only: Stomach growling, {a} eats {theItem} slowly, savouring every crumb.

event-eat-share-nothing.only: {a} hides to eat {theItem} in the dark, so nobody comes to ask for some.

event-feed-crowd.only: Spectators take pity on {a} and throw bread over the wall. {a} catches every piece.

event-feed-priest.only: A priest of the arena walks among the contestants with a basket and gives {a} a meal and a blessing.

event-feed-orchard.only: {a} finds an old orchard and eats apples until {{a:he is|she is|they are}} full.

event-feed-eggs.only: {a} climbs to a nest and comes down with four eggs, eaten raw on the spot.

event-hunger-day.success: {a} has not eaten in days, tightens {{a:his|her|their}} belt a notch, and keeps going.
event-hunger-day.failure: {a} has not eaten in days; dizzy with hunger, {a} stumbles and falls more than once.
event-hunger-day.defeated: {a} has not eaten in days and collapses in the dust; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hunger-night.success: Hunger keeps {a} awake all night, but {a} holds on until dawn.
event-hunger-night.failure: {a} chews on bark and roots all night, and gets stomach cramps for dinner.
event-hunger-night.defeated: Weakened by days of hunger, {a} does not wake up at dawn; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hunger-mirage.success: {a} sees a roast chicken floating in the air, understands it is hunger talking, and sits down to rest.
event-hunger-mirage.failure: {a} chases a roast chicken that is not there, straight into a thorn bush.
event-hunger-mirage.defeated: {a} chases a roast chicken that is not there, then falls and does not get up; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-forage-roots.success: {a} digs up wild carrots and roots; not a feast, but enough.
event-forage-roots.failure: {a} digs all afternoon and finds nothing edible but worms. {a} draws the line at worms.

event-forage-honey.success: {a} smokes out a wild hive and steals a whole comb of honey without a single sting.
event-forage-honey.failure: {a} tries to steal honey from a wild hive; the bees win.

event-forage-ceps.success: {a} picks only the right mushrooms and cooks a fine stew.
event-forage-ceps.failure: {a} picks the wrong mushrooms and sees talking trees all evening.

event-guest-gladiator-gate.win: A side gate opens and the crowd roars: {a}, a gladiator of the arena, walks in to join the games, and picks {b} as a first opponent. {a} knocks {b} down with a shield blow and turns to salute the stands.
event-guest-gladiator-gate.lose: A side gate opens and the crowd roars: {a}, a gladiator of the arena, walks in to join the games, and picks {b} as a first opponent. {b} holds firm, and {a} withdraws with a grin, promising a rematch.
event-guest-gladiator-gate.draw: A side gate opens and the crowd roars: {a}, a gladiator of the arena, walks in to join the games, and picks {b} as a first opponent. They trade blows until the crowd tires of it; {a} leaves to find other prey.
event-guest-gladiator-gate.defeat: A side gate opens and the crowd roars: {a}, a gladiator of the arena, walks in to join the games, and picks {b} as a first opponent. The gladiator knows the arena too well; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-guest-gladiator-gate.defeated: A side gate opens and the crowd roars: {a}, a gladiator of the arena, walks in to join the games, and picks {b} as a first opponent. {b} wins, to general amazement; the arena wardens carry {a} away after just one fight.

event-guest-gladiator-champion.win: The arena masters send in their reigning champion, {a}, who strides straight towards {b}. {a} toys with {b} for a while, then lets {b} flee, to the crowd's delight.
event-guest-gladiator-champion.lose: The arena masters send in their reigning champion, {a}, who strides straight towards {b}. {b} lands a lucky blow, and {a} steps back, surprised and furious.
event-guest-gladiator-champion.draw: The arena masters send in their reigning champion, {a}, who strides straight towards {b}. The fight goes on until nightfall without a winner.
event-guest-gladiator-champion.defeat: The arena masters send in their reigning champion, {a}, who strides straight towards {b}. The champion lives up to the title; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-guest-gladiator-champion.defeated: The arena masters send in their reigning champion, {a}, who strides straight towards {b}. {b} defeats the reigning champion; the arena wardens carry {a} away, and the stands go wild.

event-guest-gladiator-night.win: In the middle of the night, a new contestant climbs over the wall: {a}, who falls on {b} at once. {a} has the better of the fight, and {b} flees into the dark.
event-guest-gladiator-night.lose: In the middle of the night, a new contestant climbs over the wall: {a}, who falls on {b} at once. {b} was not asleep, and {a} has to back off.
event-guest-gladiator-night.draw: In the middle of the night, a new contestant climbs over the wall: {a}, who falls on {b} at once. They fight blind in the dark and part without a winner.
event-guest-gladiator-night.defeat: In the middle of the night, a new contestant climbs over the wall: {a}, who falls on {b} at once. By dawn, the newcomer has won; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-guest-gladiator-night.defeated: In the middle of the night, a new contestant climbs over the wall: {a}, who falls on {b} at once. {b} drives off the intruder for good; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-guest-wanderer-hermit.only: {a}, a hermit who has lived in the arena's woods for years, comes out of the trees and decides to follow {b}.

event-guest-wanderer-deserter.only: {a}, an arena guard sick of the games, throws away the uniform and joins {b}.

event-guest-wanderer-volunteer.only: A spectator, {a}, jumps over the barrier, shouting to fight alongside {b}. The arena masters let it happen.

event-visitor-gift.only: A spectator in the front row throws {item} into the arena, right at the feet of {a}.

event-visitor-child.only: A child slips under the barrier, hands {item} to {a}, and runs back to a furious parent.

event-visitor-healer.only: A healer from the stands bribes a guard and spends an hour tending the wounds of {a}.

event-visitor-bard.only: A bard in the stands improvises a song about {a}. By evening, half the arena is singing it.

event-visitor-merchant.success: A merchant slips through the bars and haggles with {a}, who leaves with {item} for a song.
event-visitor-merchant.failure: A merchant slips through the bars and offers {a} wonders, at prices nobody in the arena can pay.

event-visitor-stones.success: Angry spectators throw stones at {a}, who dodges them all and bows mockingly.
event-visitor-stones.failure: Angry spectators throw stones at {a}; a few hit their mark.
event-visitor-stones.defeated: Angry spectators throw stones at {a}, so many that the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-visitor-fortune.only: An old fortune teller calls to {a} through the bars: "You will see the end of these games." Then she laughs, and leaves.

event-visitor-noble.only: A noble lady in the stands is moved by the courage of {a} and has {item} sent down by a servant.

event-relic-search.success: {a} searches the ruins and finds it, under a fallen column: the golden relic.
event-relic-search.failure: {a} searches the ruins all day for the relic and finds only rubble.

event-relic-clues.success: {a} deciphers the old signs carved in the arena walls, follows them, and digs up the relic.
event-relic-clues.failure: {a} follows the signs carved in the walls, which lead to a latrine pit. Someone has a sense of humour.

event-relic-tracks.success: {a} follows the tracks of the guards who hid the relic, all the way to a hollow tree.
event-relic-tracks.failure: {a} follows tracks for hours, and ends up face to face with a very surprised deer.

event-relic-steal.success: {a} creeps up on {b} and snatches the relic away without a sound.
event-relic-steal.failure: {a} creeps up on {b} to take the relic, steps on a branch, and has to run.
event-relic-steal.caught: {a} tries to take the relic from {b}, who was waiting for it; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-relic-steal.seized: {a} tries to take the relic from {b}; the fight that follows ends with {b} carried away by the wardens, and the relic changes hands.

event-relic-ambush.success: {a} jumps on {b} and tears the relic from {{b:his|her|their}} hands.
event-relic-ambush.failure: {a} jumps on {b} to grab the relic; {b} holds on and gets away.
event-relic-ambush.caught: {a} jumps on {b} to grab the relic, and loses the fight; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-relic-ambush.seized: {a} jumps on {b}, wins the fight, and takes the relic; the arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-relic-return.success: Relic in hand, {a} runs across the arena and reaches the gates.
event-relic-return.failure: Relic in hand, {a} runs for the gates, but the guards close them and point the other way.

event-relic-sneak.success: Under cover of night, {a} slips past everyone and lays the relic at the gates.
event-relic-sneak.failure: {a} tries to sneak to the gates with the relic, but its golden glint gives the hiding place away.

event-tool-heat.success: A crushing heat falls on the arena; {a} finds shade and waits for evening.
event-tool-heat.failure: A crushing heat falls on the arena; {a} walks too long under the sun and stumbles, dizzy.
event-tool-heat.defeated: A crushing heat falls on the arena, and {a} collapses from thirst; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-heat.tool: A crushing heat falls on the arena; {a} drinks from {theItem} and walks on, fresh as a daisy.

event-tool-fire-night.success: {a} rubs two sticks together for an hour and finally gets a fire going.
event-tool-fire-night.failure: {a} rubs two sticks together all night and gets nothing but blisters and a cold.
event-tool-fire-night.defeated: Without a fire, {a} spends a freezing night in the rain and cannot go on; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tool-fire-night.tool: {a} strikes {theItem} and has a merry fire going in no time.

event-tool-cook.success: {a} finds wild herbs and eats them raw. Not great, but filling.
event-tool-cook.failure: {a} catches a fish but cannot cook it, and cannot bring {{a:himself|herself|themself}} to eat it raw.
event-tool-cook.tool: {a} lights a fire with {theItem} and cooks a real meal. The smell drives everyone around mad.

event-tool-net-fish.success: {a} builds a little dam of stones and traps a few fish in it.
event-tool-net-fish.failure: {a} tries to trap fish behind a dam of stones; the fish go around it.
event-tool-net-fish.tool: {a} casts {theItem} into the river and pulls it out heavy with fish.

event-tame-net.success: {a} chases {animal} through the undergrowth, corners it, and slowly wins its trust.
event-tame-net.failure: {a} chases {animal} through the undergrowth and gets scratched for nothing.
event-tame-net.defeated: {a} corners {animal}, which turns on its hunter; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-net.tool: {a} throws {theItem} over {animal}, waits until the struggling stops, and makes a friend for life.

event-tame-call.success: {a} imitates the cry of a hawk so well that a real one comes down, curious, and stays.
event-tame-call.failure: {a} imitates the cry of a hawk; the hawk comes down, decides it was an insult, and attacks.
event-tame-call.defeated: {a} imitates a hawk call on the edge of a cliff, gets too excited, and falls; the arena wardens carry {a} away.
event-tame-call.tool: {a} blows into {theItem}; a hawk answers, circles, and lands on {{a:his|her|their}} arm.

event-druid-bear.success: {a} speaks to a bear in the old tongue of the forest. The bear bows its huge head and follows.
event-druid-bear.failure: {a} speaks to a bear in the old tongue of the forest; this bear speaks another dialect, and swipes.
event-druid-bear.defeated: {a} speaks to a bear in the old tongue of the forest, a little too slowly; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-beast-friend-pack.only: At night, wild animals come to sleep around {a} and {theAnimal}. Nobody dares come near.

event-tracker-hunt.success: {a} reads a deer's tracks like a book and comes back with dinner.
event-tracker-hunt.failure: {a} follows a deer for hours; the deer is a better tracker.

event-favourite-cheers.only: The whole arena chants the name of {a}. Carried by the cheers, {a} forgets every bruise.

event-climber-lookout.success: {a} climbs the tallest tower of the arena, spots a forgotten cache from up there, and comes back with {item}.
event-climber-lookout.failure: {a} climbs the tallest tower of the arena for the view, and finds the view is all there is.

event-night-eyes-scout.success: While the others stumble in the dark, {a} walks the arena as in daylight, and picks up {item}.
event-night-eyes-scout.failure: {a} walks the arena all night with those cat's eyes, and finds that everyone else hid their things well.

event-iron-stomach-feast.only: {a} eats a raw toad, a handful of beetles and some moss, and declares it a fine meal.

event-cleric-blessing.success: {a} kneels and prays; a warm light closes the worst of the wounds.
event-cleric-blessing.failure: {a} kneels and prays all night. The gods are busy elsewhere.

event-bard-song.only: {a} sings for the stands, and the crowd pays in bread, cheese and apples thrown over the wall.

event-rogue-locks.success: {a} slips into the guards' storeroom in the night and leaves with {item}.
event-rogue-locks.failure: {a} slips into the guards' storeroom in the night; it is full of guards.

event-barbarian-rage.success: A tree falls across the path of {a}, who lifts it with a roar and throws it aside.
event-barbarian-rage.failure: A tree falls across the path of {a}, who tries to lift it, and pulls something in the back.
event-barbarian-rage.defeated: A tree falls right on {a}, who tries to hold it up, alone; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-mage-portal.success: A rune of the arena flares under the feet of {a}, who unravels the spell before it goes off.
event-mage-portal.failure: A rune of the arena flares under the feet of {a} and throws {{a:him|her|them}} twenty paces away.
event-mage-portal.defeated: A rune of the arena flares under the feet of {a} and teleports {{a:him|her|them}} straight outside; the arena wardens carry {a} to the infirmary.

announcements.announce-finale: Only {all} remain. The arena masters close the gates: the finale begins, one duel after another.
announcements.announce-next-duel: Without catching {{a:his|her|their}} breath, {a} turns to face {b}.
announcements.announce-team-out: It is over for {team}: the team's last member has fallen.
announcements.announce-recap-day: The sun sets. Out of the arena today: {all}.
announcements.announce-recap-night: Dawn breaks. Out of the arena tonight: {all}.
announcements.announce-quiet-day: The sun sets on a day without losses: nobody left the arena.
announcements.announce-quiet-night: Dawn breaks after a night without losses: nobody left the arena.
announcements.announce-decree-survive: Trumpets sound, and the arena masters raise their hands: whoever still stands at dawn on day {count} will share the victory.
announcements.announce-decree-relic: Trumpets sound: a golden relic has been hidden somewhere in the arena. Whoever brings it back to the gates wins the games.
announcements.announce-decree-champion: Trumpets sound: the crowd wants a champion. The first to have put {count} opponents out of the arena wins the games.
announcements.announce-decree-won-survive: Dawn breaks and the trumpets sound: {all} are still standing, and share the victory.
announcements.announce-decree-won-relic: The gates open before the relic: the games are over, and the victory goes to {all}.
announcements.announce-decree-won-champion: The crowd roars for its champion: the games are over, and the victory goes to {all}.
